```sql
SELECT player_id, player_name,
       SUM(pts) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN game_id END) AS points_per_game,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN game_id END) AS games_played
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017
  AND player_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN game_id END) >= 20
ORDER BY points_per_game DESC, player_name ASC
LIMIT 10
```
